_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Hennessy's serves food but no menu was found. These five pub classics are sample dishes for the demo only. Replace them with the kitchen's real dishes before this goes anywhere public.

items.name: Beef & Guinness pie
items.description: Beef braised in Guinness under a shortcrust lid, with mash and greens.

items.name: Fish & chips
items.description: Battered haddock, thick-cut chips, mushy peas and tartare sauce.

items.name: Sausage & mash
items.description: Pork sausages on buttery mash with onion gravy.

items.name: Irish stew
items.description: Lamb, potato and root vegetables, with soda bread and butter.

items.name: Ham & cheese toastie
items.description: Thick-cut ham and mature cheddar, toasted, with pickle on the side.
